source.title: Mayo Clinic Laboratories — AMH1: Antimullerian Hormone, Serum
source.methodLocation: Method Name/Specimen, PDF page 1; Method Description, PDF page 5
source.rangeVersion: No independent effective date supplied in catalogue; date above is retrieval/generation, not an invented source revision.

method.name: Roche Elecsys AMH ECLIA
method.description: Two-site immunometric sandwich assay with electrochemiluminescence detection. Catalogue cites Elecsys AMH package insert 2.0 English 10/2022; that insert was not independently retrieved.

population.description: Catalogue sex- and age-specific reference intervals. Cohort N, ethnicity, gestational age and premature-birth inclusion are not specified. Intervals are Mayo-derived unless otherwise designated per catalogue introduction.

ageRoutingPolicy: Interpret integer source age labels as completed years: 2–12 -> [2,13), >12 -> [13,infinity), 45–50 -> [45,51). Application routing convention, not a formula published by Mayo. Qualify the full known age interval; upper bound at the next group is allowed only when exclusive.

applicationGuards.prematureGuardOrigin: Conservative application policy because no preterm-specific reference is published; NOT a Mayo gestational-age or one-year exclusion criterion. No transplanted Johannsen/Greaves GA thresholds.
applicationGuards.unknownBirthContext: May receive orientative general age/sex catalogue comparison; does not assert term birth.
applicationGuards.method: Unknown permits source comparison without confirming sample method. Known incompatible assay/kit is excluded.
applicationGuards.specimen: Unknown permits source comparison; known non-serum excluded.
applicationGuards.menopause: Not inferred from age. Age rows remain age references, including older women; no transplantation of >55 row to younger postmenopausal women.
applicationGuards.cycle: No phase-specific RI in catalogue; relatively stable concentrations per Clinical Information, so no required cycle selector.
applicationGuards.tanner: No stage-specific RI; no Tanner V-to-adult inference.
applicationGuards.knownContraindication: Known treatment/stimulation or other supplied contraindication is outside this generic age comparison; no adapted treatment norms are implemented.

notReferenceRanges: Midpoints or means/medians inferred from reference limits
